title: When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and a caching HTTP reverse proxy is used in front of DNSdist, it is possible to pollute…
description: A vulnerability exists in DNSdist when DNS over HTTPS (DoH) is enabled and a caching HTTP reverse proxy is used in front of it. The issue allows an attacker to pollute the cache of the HTTP reverse proxy by sending DoH GET queries that include a body. DNSdist incorrectly processes the HTTP body content instead of ignoring it or refusing such queries, leading to potential cache poisoning.
